research_question: Can evidence-triggered generation of conjunctive causal interactions absent from the initial three-way parity bank improve held action-consequence prediction without degrading familiar-rule retention?
source: Six binary interventions; signed XOR of 3 parents (40 rules), optionally XOR with AND of two nonparent intervention bits (120 novel rules). Hidden rule identities never sent to the learner.
birth_trigger: After 8 observations, minimum old-rule mismatches >=2; or after 16 observations, >=3. Upon trigger generate all 120 new signed triple-XOR plus disjoint pairwise-AND rules by composing known triples with a new interaction feature. Fitted by identical current observed action receipts. No generative-world labels used.
controls: Exact fully fitted posterior over original 40 known rules
Exact fully fitted posterior over all 160 candidate rules, including new interactions, always available as strong conventional rule-grammar control
Fully trained kernel ridge regression on all 160 candidate rule features, exact same public intervention observations
Hard MAP ablation with the born bank
probability: Fixed 1/8 Bernoulli observation-error likelihood, 7/8 total old family prior and 1/8 total new family prior, uniformly within each family. Compare correct clean held causal outcomes. Binary predictions tie to zero.
safety: Unprotected source-free synthetic computational development only. No original action sources, native checkpoint, first-use, runner, controller, merge, scheduler, or model integration.

frozen_development_gates.novel_birth_rate: At least 80% of novel-world tests in each corruption stratum trigger expansion
frozen_development_gates.novel_accuracy: At least 90% held accuracy with zero corrupted training labels, >=80% with two flips
frozen_development_gates.novel_gain_vs_old: At least 10 percentage points above old bank held accuracy in both corruption strata
frozen_development_gates.strong_control_parity: Within 1 percentage point of full-grammar exact Bayesian control in BOTH novel-world corruption strata
frozen_development_gates.false_birth: At most 10% false generation on original-world clean evidence and at most 20% under two corrupted observations
frozen_development_gates.efficiency: No speed claim unless complete independent CPU benchmark confirms >=1.5x wall speedup over complete full-bank inference at matched accuracy. Not a gate for scientific promotion.

qualification: All five first development gates must pass on each stratum or classify DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Exact control matching is not an energy-exclusive improvement. Full native training, original first-use and independent scientific qualification are separate and not authorized here. No post-score tuning.
